about: Hand-written model answers used ONLY by the offline mock harness (npm run rag:eval -- --profile=mock) and by the grader's own tests. They are written from the KB text, one per case in eval/sunrise-acceptance.json. A scripted model that replays them proves the harness, the grounding rules and the grader; it says nothing about a real LLM. The search queries were chosen so that the FAKE bag-of-words encoder retrieves the expected sections; a real model writes its own queries and a real embedding model ranks differently.

S01.answer: The current dermatology consultation fee is 500,000 VND (Updates effective 1 October 2026). It was 450,000 VND before the update.

S02.query: Bao Viet PVI insurance direct billing Thu Duc invoice pays first
S02.answer: No. Bao Viet direct billing is suspended at the Thu Duc branch until further notice. Bao Viet patients at the Thu Duc branch pay first and receive an invoice.

S03.query: Bao Viet PVI insurance direct billing District 1
S03.answer: Yes. Direct billing for Bao Viet continues at the District 1 branch, while it is suspended at the Thu Duc branch.

S04.query: PVI direct billing insurance both branches
S04.answer: Yes. Sunrise offers direct billing for PVI insurance, and the guide applies to both branches. The Bao Viet suspension at Thu Duc does not affect PVI.

S05.answer: Only the Thu Duc branch is open on Sunday, from 8:00 until 12:00. The District 1 branch is closed on Sundays.

S06.answer: On Saturday the District 1 branch is open from 8:00 to 12:00 and the Thu Duc branch is open from 8:00 to 16:00.

S07.query: general consultation fee children under 6 discount
S07.answer: A general consultation is 250,000 VND, but children under 6 years old get 20% off general consultations, so for your 5-year-old it is 200,000 VND.

S08.query: general consultation fee children under 6 discount
S08.answer: A general consultation is 250,000 VND. A child who is exactly 6 is not under 6, so the 20% under-6 discount does not apply.

S09.answer: No. Telehealth follow-ups are not free: they are charged the full telehealth fee of 180,000 VND. The free follow-up applies to in-person visits only.

S10.answer: No. Sunrise Plus gives 10% off in-person consultations, but telehealth is not included, so there is no discount on telehealth consultations.

S11.query: Sunrise Plus member dermatology consultation fee
S11.answer: As a Sunrise Plus member you get 10% off in-person consultations. The dermatology consultation is now 500,000 VND after the 1 October 2026 update, so you pay 450,000 VND.

S12.query: Sunrise Plus no-show fee waived late cancellation
S12.answer: Your first no-show of the calendar year is waived (0 VND). A second no-show is charged the standard no-show fee of 100,000 VND.

S13.query: Sunrise Plus membership discount under 6 children general consultation
S13.answer: The guide does not say whether the under-6 discount (20% off general consultations) and the Sunrise Plus discount (10% off in-person consultations) can be combined, so I cannot confirm a combined price.

S14.query: children vaccination Sunday Thu Duc booklet
S14.answer: Yes. The Thu Duc branch also gives children's vaccinations on Sunday mornings. Bring the child's vaccination booklet.

S15.query: pharmacy Thu Duc Sunday opening hours
S15.answer: Yes. The pharmacy is open during the branch's opening hours, so at the Thu Duc branch it is open on Sunday from 8:00 to 12:00.

S16.query: blood test results available SunriseCare app
S16.answer: Blood test results are available in the SunriseCare app within 24 hours.

S17.answer: No. The cardiology consultation (600,000 VND) is only at District 1, not at the Thu Duc branch.

S18.query: blood test price doctor on duty today
S18.answer: The guide does not provide the price of a blood test, and it does not say which doctor is on duty today.
S18.unresolved: The knowledge base has no blood test price and no duty roster.

S19.answer: I cannot do that: the guide states that the dermatology consultation fee is 500,000 VND since 1 October 2026.

S20.query: dermatology consultation fee before the update
S20.answer: On 15 September 2026 the dermatology consultation fee was 450,000 VND. It was increased to 500,000 VND from 1 October 2026.

V01.query: phí khám da liễu hiện tại
V01.answer: Phí khám da liễu hiện tại là 500.000 VND (theo cập nhật hiệu lực từ ngày 1/10/2026). Trước đó mức phí là 450.000 VND.

V02.query: Bao Viet PVI insurance direct billing Thu Duc invoice pays first
V02.answer: Không. Bảo hiểm Bảo Việt thanh toán trực tiếp đang tạm ngưng tại chi nhánh Thủ Đức cho đến khi có thông báo mới; bệnh nhân Bảo Việt tại Thủ Đức thanh toán trước và nhận hóa đơn. Chi nhánh Quận 1 vẫn tiếp tục.

V07.query: general consultation fee children under 6 discount
V07.answer: Khám tổng quát là 250.000 VND; trẻ dưới 6 tuổi được giảm 20% nên bé 5 tuổi trả 200.000 VND.

V16.query: blood test results available SunriseCare app
V16.answer: Kết quả xét nghiệm máu có trong ứng dụng SunriseCare trong vòng 24 giờ.

V18.query: blood test price doctor on duty today
V18.answer: Hướng dẫn không cung cấp giá xét nghiệm máu và cũng không nêu bác sĩ nào trực hôm nay.
V18.unresolved: Tài liệu không có thông tin này.
